Career Objective
To work in an organization where I can use my skills and knowledge to deliver value
added results that provides me job satisfaction and self development which help me
achieve personal as well as organizational goals.

Work Experience

Global Payroll Specialist
Cognizant Technologies Pvt Ltd
Sep, 2022 - Present

1.Processing US Payroll for third party client (Paycheck) using Core Advance
software and mode of payroll is Email payroll.
2.Maintenance of Employees in the client server Core Advance (CA)
3.Setting up organisation units in the CA.
4.Decoding of Employees Direct deposit and federal withholdings in the CA

Accounts Executive
JNIT Technologies(Magellanic Cloud Ltd)
Jan, 2022 - Aug, 2022

1) Preparation of payroll sheet as per employee wise and enter the hours from the
timesheets.
2) Adjust Closing balance to opening balance (while doing that make sure that
deductions which are removing must be matched with payroll journal).
3) Add Medical Insurance in the payroll sheet which was received from the HR
team (make sure that it should match PDF with excel).
4) Copy payroll month hours from google drive and paste it in payroll sheet in the
second tab.
5) Take a new project list & project end & left list from the Accounts team and
update the payroll sheet accordingly.
6) Take a new project list and send email to employees for address confirmation
(with Paychex address).
7) Prepare project end & LEFT employees list and ask the accounts team towards
Vendor due balance and run accordingly.



8) LEFT employees details are provided in the HR & Payroll skype group and ask
for if the employee has any pending balance.
9) Check the last 30 days emails and make adjustments in the payroll sheet
accordingly.
10) Prepare timesheet hours which need to be sent to HR (which includes
employee visa status, hours, last period and queries)
11) Prepare an LCA sheet which needs to be sent to HR (whom it requires)
12) Prepare run on others list as per buffer sheet and send to HR (whom it is
require)

Junior Accountant
Mahendra Nath&Co
Nov, 2020 - Jan, 2022

1.Invoicing
